page.overview:
What is The View?

The View is the second song on the Metallica and Lou Reed album Lulu.

"The View" is the sole single from the Metallica & Lou Reed album Lulu, released on September 27, 2011

The View has been performed live 1 time by Metallica as of February, 2025.

The View was performed live at The Fillmore, San Francisco, CA, USA on December 7, 2011.
